answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 157 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The timber graph is validated at intake and the comet frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and oasis anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 283 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
